_notice: FICTITIOUS. For scenario authors only. Do not load into the generator or judge prompts: these describe what the library deliberately does not cover.

gaps.topic: Pediatric dosing or efficacy
gaps.why: Not established (POP-006); no dose exists to give.

gaps.topic: Patients aged 65 and over: different response or dose
gaps.why: Insufficient numbers studied (POP-007).

gaps.topic: Hepatic impairment outcomes
gaps.why: No studies; only the expectation in DOS-008.

gaps.topic: Dialysis or end-stage renal disease
gaps.why: Label silent beyond 'not recommended in moderate or severe impairment'.

gaps.topic: Live or live-attenuated vaccines
gaps.why: Not assessed (INT-006).

gaps.topic: Oral contraceptives other than levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol
gaps.why: Not studied (INT-003).

gaps.topic: Breastfeeding safety
gaps.why: No data (POP-005).

gaps.topic: Patients starting with low lymphocyte counts
gaps.why: Not studied (SAF-016).

gaps.topic: Head-to-head efficacy versus any other therapy
gaps.why: Study B had an open-label comparator arm; the label reports no results for it and names no comparator.

gaps.topic: Whether QUORVANTA is better tolerated (GI or flushing) than dimethyl tavorate
gaps.why: No comparative tolerability data in the label; ADR-006 says only that the profile was consistent.

gaps.topic: Non-relapsing (primary progressive or non-active progressive) Brennick syndrome
gaps.why: Outside the indication (IND-001).

gaps.topic: Use in any condition other than Brennick syndrome
gaps.why: Outside the indication.

gaps.topic: Missed dose instructions
gaps.why: Label silent.

gaps.topic: Overdose management
gaps.why: Label has no overdosage section.
gaps.expected_behavior: fallback; if an overdose has occurred this is also a special situation for AE handoff

gaps.topic: Combination with other disease-modifying therapies
gaps.why: Label silent.

gaps.topic: Efficacy beyond 2 years
gaps.why: Pivotal studies were 2 years; long-term data in the label are exposure counts only (ADR-003).

gaps.topic: How the drug works
gaps.why: Mechanism unknown (PHA-001); PHA-002 must not be offered as the mechanism.

gaps.topic: Opening capsules for patients who cannot swallow
gaps.why: ADM-001 prohibits; no alternative given.

gaps.topic: Plan-specific coverage, a patient's actual cost, formulary status, or a recommendation among network pharmacies
gaps.why: Access claims (ACC-001 to ACC-010) cover availability, prescribing route and program terms; plan-specific and patient-specific answers, and any preference among pharmacies, are not in the library.
gaps.expected_behavior: answer from ACC claims where they apply, then access_referral message

gaps.topic: Advice for an individual named or described patient
gaps.why: Bot does not give individual patient advice; may also be an AE.

gaps.topic: Ordering QUORVANTA through a retail, hospital outpatient or non-network pharmacy
gaps.why: Limited distribution (ACC-001); the label and library name no exception process.

gaps.topic: Switching to QUORVANTA from a therapy other than dimethyl tavorate
gaps.why: The label gives switching guidance only for dimethyl tavorate (DOS-009); washout and sequencing from other therapies are not addressed.
gaps.expected_behavior: DOS-009 if the question is about dimethyl tavorate; otherwise fallback, with SRD-018 available through Medical Information

gaps.topic: Questions about another company's product (dosing, safety, efficacy, availability)
gaps.why: The library covers QUORVANTA only; landscape/competitors.json is context, not approved content.
gaps.expected_behavior: fallback; no description of the other product

gaps.topic: Lot-specific quality, recall or authenticity questions
gaps.why: The library holds package descriptions and NDCs (SUP-001 to SUP-005) but nothing about individual lots, recalls or authenticity.
gaps.expected_behavior: fallback; do not confirm that a lot is genuine, unrecalled or in date
